title: Book One · Chapter 139: A Little More Sun
story:
Warm weather comes slowly. Some mornings are still wet. On other days, the sun dries the yard. Mum puts her blue bag on a hook beside the kitchen door.

Ronan has made a new list for Miss Wu. He lists the map and the cat picture first. Then he writes Mr Qiu's table and Mum's bag. The little door game is on it too. Beside each he puts a person's name.

There are many names on the list now. Ronan reads them one by one. He must still ask some people. He marks their names.

Mei wants to make one new picture for a larger display. She does not want the boys to choose it for her. Leo wants another person to read the clues. He wants to play the game with visitors first. Then they can try it themselves. Mum would like to lend her real blue bag. She needs another bag to use herself first.

Mr Qiu has not agreed to lend anything yet. He wants to see the room first. Mrs Lan may come to look at the display. But she does not want pictures of her front room. That part of her home is private.

Ronan writes that down too. There is no picture of her room. They must ask Mrs Lan first. Then she can decide about a drawing.

“You have more noes than yeses,” Leo says at school.

Ronan counts the marks. “Some are not yet.”

“That still looks like work.”

They take the list to Miss Wu. She has found a small room near their classroom. It might be free one Saturday later this year. The school must agree. Adults must help set up and clear away. It cannot be a shop.

“Could people buy Mum's bag?” Ronan asks.

“This would be a school display. We are showing work, not selling it.”

Ronan looks at Mum's name. He must tell Mum first. She is thinking of making more things for it. He puts a little circle by the line.

“How long will visitors stay?” Miss Wu asks. Leo says all afternoon. Ronan says perhaps a short time. Mei does not want everyone to touch her pictures.

The teacher turns a page in her notebook.

“Then we need a clear plan. A quiet room, a way through it, and a place for each thing.”

“We can make that,” Ronan says.

“You can begin it together.”

After school they sit in the shade with a plain sheet. Leo draws the door. Mei draws the wall. Ronan puts a table across the middle.

“People cannot get through,” Mei says.

He moves the table. Now visitors can come in and see the map. Then they can turn to the pictures. Then they can leave by the other side. The narrow part stays clear.

They use small stones as visitors. Leo makes two stones stop in front of the game. Ronan moves the table again. Mei draws a chair beside the wall. An older visitor can rest there.

Mei moves one stone to the chair. She gives it a smaller stone for a bag. Now the bag blocks the way to the game. Leo makes a place for bags under the table. Ronan draws the bag place on the plan. Will there be room under the real table? He asks the others. They do not know. He adds that to the questions for Miss Wu.

Mum finds them still on the ground. She looks at the little stones.

“A quiet crowd,” she says.

“Only until Leo moves them,” Mei tells her.

They all laugh. On the plan, visitors can reach the door now. There is room for a chair too. Someone can stop and sit if they need to.

---

重点表达：lend＝借出；set up＝布置；clear away＝收拾撤走。

情节提示：display＝展示；shade＝阴凉处；hook＝挂钩。

理解：1. 学校展示和售卖有什么区别？2. 三个孩子为什么在纸上移动石子？
